root_cause.text: A data race in `l2tp_tunnel_del_work()` because it reads `sk->sk_socket` without any synchronization while another thread concurrently clears it to NULL during socket release (`sk_common_release`), and this read was performed unconditionally even for user-space sockets where it was unnecessary.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `sk->sk_socket` read from the function entry (line 1418) into the conditional block for kernel sockets (`if (tunnel->fd < 0)`), preventing the race for user sockets. The KCSAN report confirms the concurrent write (setting `sk->sk_socket` to NULL) by `sk_common_release` and the read by `l2tp_tunnel_del_work`.
